class.name: ScreenShakeBase
class.brief_description: Base class for the screen shake nodes.
class.description: Base class of [ScreenShake2D] and [ScreenShake3D]. Uses a trauma value: each call to [method shake] adds trauma, which decreases over time. The shake intensity is the square of the trauma, so small hits are subtle and big ones are strong.

method.name: shake
method.description: Adds [param strength] to the trauma (clamped to [code]1[/code]), which starts or intensifies the shake.

method.name: stop
method.description: Stops the shake immediately and restores the camera.

members.member: The camera to shake. If empty, the parent node is used.
